name: shipmate
description: Delivers engineering work from local requirements, with reviews, walkthroughs and quizzes for local changes and pull requests.

interface.longDescription: Five public actions—Specify, Run, Review, Walkthrough and Quiz—backed by internal engineering delivery procedures.
defaultPrompt: Use shipmate:specify to prepare a reviewed engineering contract.
Use shipmate:run to deliver local requirements to a verified draft pull request.
Use shipmate:review to challenge a specification, plan or candidate.
Use shipmate:walkthrough to explain this merge request or local change in layers.
Use shipmate:quiz to check my understanding of this merge request or local change and show a report.
